hints.title: Subarray Length Parity Equivalence
hints.text: Notice that a subarray length is divisible by k if and only if both prefix sum indices share the same remainder modulo k.

hints.title: Remainder Bucket Maintenance
hints.text: Maintain an array of size k storing the minimum prefix sum encountered for each index modulo k.

hints.title: Global Max Subarray Update
hints.text: For each ending index, subtract the stored minimum prefix sum of matching remainder and update the answer.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Tracks minimal prefix sum for each index remainder modulo k.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all candidate subarrays with divisible length takes O(n^2 / k).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(k) memory caches minimum prefix sum per remainder.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses prefix sums partitioned by index % k to achieve linear time.
